void.$description: Void — Page canvas and primary surface — the base layer beneath all artwork, slightly lifted from pure black to prevent OLED banding in the dark void

absolute.$description: Absolute — Hairline borders, image containers, icon strokes, footer dividers — pure black acts as the structural ink that defines edges in the absence of visible card surfaces

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated footer surface and deeper UI panels — a single step up from canvas for zone separation without breaking the dark void

faint.$description: Faint — Shadow base for subtle elevation effects — nearly invisible against canvas, used in box-shadow compositions for soft ambient lift

bone.$description: Bone — Primary text color, nav item fills, filled button background — warm off-white replaces pure white to soften contrast against the black void and reduce eye strain

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary body text, subdued helper labels, muted metadata — sits one step below Bone for non-emphasized copy without losing legibility on dark surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text and border accents on headings — used sparingly for fine print and inactive labels that should recede

live-wire.$description: Live Wire — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

inter-display.$description: Primary typeface across all UI, body, navigation, and headings — used exclusively at weight 400 with no weight variation, creating a flat, even visual texture where size and spacing alone carry hierarchy. Substitute with Inter (free, near-identical metrics).

system-sans-serif.$description: Micro-UI labels (12px) — system stack for the smallest utility text where font loading overhead isn't justified
